FINDINGS 24 is fixed: the host continuation now reaches every guest line and the closer, and nesting.md@40 agrees outright. The one hunk left is not markdown's and not the splice. Our json package hard-breaks any array of two or more objects; prettier's boundary is narrower -- it breaks only when EVERY element is an object or array with more than one child, verified live against prettier 3.9.6 (four 1-key objects stay flat, two 2-key objects break, a mixed pair stays flat). No predicate expresses a per-child minimum arity: child_count is a total across siblings, so [{a,b,c},{a}] and [{a,b},{a,b}] are indistinguishable to it. Measured the only expressible alternative -- dropping the hard branch for the width-based one -- and it takes JSON's own corpus from 6/6 to 4/6, so the current rule is the better of the two policies the IR can state.
